package.name: island_interfaces
package.description: Build-order shim: resolves the UNION interface closure of every island node in one nros_find_interfaces call, so exactly one superset FFI archive exists (nano-ros issue 0253 — per-call topo-last crates from different dep subsets would otherwise miss or duplicate symbols). First entry in the workspace SUBDIRS; all node pkgs' interface calls then no-op idempotently.
